mirrorHostMatrix.title: Mirror host matrix (read-only probe)
mirrorHostMatrix.subtitle: Live from /diag mirrorHosts - the same {host,status,note} rows the CI step summary prints. Read-only GET of each host API root: token-less guest mode - no upload, no credential, no evasion.
mirrorHostMatrix.empty: no host rows from /diag (server unreachable or ghrdp-mirror.ps1 not staged)
mirrorHostMatrix.unreachable: /diag unreachable - the runner dashboard is not answering
mirrorHostMatrix.optionVps: Run the mirror upload from an operator-owned VPS egress that you configure yourself (payloads/Provision-GhrdpVps.ps1).
mirrorHostMatrix.optionAccept: Accept that the mirror is unavailable from ephemeral runners and leave it off (mirror_enable=false).
mirrorHostMatrix.optionDisable: Disable the mirror (mirror_enable=false) - no upload is attempted.
mirrorHostMatrix.optionSelfHosted: Point the mirror at a self-hosted operator target you control.
mirrorHostMatrix.optionTokenFuture: Token mode is a separate future decision, out of scope here (this build never accepts or stores a host token).
mirrorHostMatrix.optionsFooter: A 403 from the runner egress or a 'host requires account token; token-less mode unsupported' reason is a policy dead-end, not a puzzle: host-policy workarounds are refused by design and blocked by a CI gate. Re-dispatch with mirror_enable=false, or move the upload to your own egress.
